blocks.text: The AI chatbot that started the revolution - now with tools and agents

ChatGPT needs little introduction - it brought AI assistants to mainstream awareness and remains the most widely used AI chatbot globally. Its strength lies in versatility: from writing emails and analyzing data to generating images and browsing the web, ChatGPT handles an unusually broad range of tasks competently.

The GPT-4o model offers multimodal capabilities - understanding and generating text, images, and code in a unified conversation. For teams using AI as a general-purpose productivity tool, this breadth means fewer context switches between specialized tools.

Custom GPTs let teams create purpose-built AI assistants for specific workflows. Build a GPT trained on your company documentation for internal Q&A, a customer-facing GPT for product support, or a specialized research assistant for your industry. Each GPT carries its own instructions, knowledge, and capabilities.
Text, image, and code understanding in unified conversations
Real-time internet access for current information and research
Generate and edit images directly in conversation
Build specialized AI assistants for specific use cases
Execute code, analyze data, and create visualizations
Natural voice conversations with the AI assistant
ChatGPT's versatility makes it the Swiss Army knife of AI assistants. For teams not sure where to start with AI, it provides the broadest capability set in a single tool.
Our team can integrate ChatGPT into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
